name: Eon Lance
description: Hurl a lance of an eon of memory through the foe's guard of mind.

name: Eon Ward
description: Hold a ward of eons kept whole that no forgetting can wear down.

name: Eon Seal
description: Seal a foe's recall of an entire art behind an eon the foe never lived.

name: Eon Prompt
description: Prompt an ally with an eon-old line of mastery and the ally's body takes it up whole.

name: Eon Mirror
description: Hold up a mirror of eons and return a mind-reaching technique to the one who sent it.

name: Eon Unmaking
description: Unmake an eon of a foe's remembered life with no wound upon the flesh.

name: Eon Replay
description: Replay an eon of a region's memory in one view and read every act that shaped it.

name: Eon Torrent
description: Pour a torrent of eons over a host so that none of them can hold a thought.

name: Eon Memory
description: The canon's closing school move that fills allies with the eon and drives it into the foe at a depth set by the user's reserve.

name: Eon Record
description: Set an eon-deep record round the company that no rewriting can pass and no forgetting can wear at a depth set by the user's reserve.

name: Eon Silence
description: Seal a foe's recall of its own name and purpose for a time that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Eonflood
description: Flood a field with the memory of eons and break every stance within it up to the destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: Unforgotten Name
description: The one thing no cultivation energy mechanic explains: the user speaks the name of a person or thing that a seal or a curse has erased from every mind and for a single exchange all in the field remember it as if it had never been taken; every use is a Part 27 consequence event.
